title.value: A Heat Diffusion Perspective on Geodesic Preserving Dimensionality Reduction
title.justification: The title of the paper directly reflects the core focus of the research, which presents a heat diffusion perspective for geodesic preserving dimensionality reduction, and is consistent with the author's contributions.
title.quote: A Heat Diffusion Perspective on Geodesic Preserving Dimensionality Reduction

extractions.description: The paper explores a novel heat diffusion-based methodology for manifold learning and dimensionality reduction, offering a new theoretical link between heat diffusion and manifold distances in high-dimensional, noisy datasets. It introduces 'heat geodesic embeddings' to enhance preservation of geodesic distances and improve data denoising, showing improvements over existing state-of-the-art methods across various datasets, including single cell RNA-sequencing data.

primary_category.justification: The paper describes a method for dimensionality reduction and manifold learning that could potentially be applied in climate science for dealing with complex, high-dimensional datasets, such as those encountered in climate modeling.
primary_category.quote: We also showcase our method on single cell RNA-sequencing datasets with both continuum and cluster structure...

secondary_categories.justification: The main focus of the paper is on mathematical and computational techniques for dimensionality reduction, not directly on eco-responsible applications.
secondary_categories.quote: Diffusion-based manifold learning methods, based on the data diffusion operator... have emerged as methods for analyzing high throughput noisy data in various situations.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's methodologies are general-purpose techniques and are presented without specific reference to a particular eco-responsible sub-category or application within the notes provided.
primary_sub_category.quote: The advent of high throughput and high dimensional data in various fields of science have made dimensionality reduction and visualization techniques an indispensable part of exploratory analysis.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Given the technical nature of the paper, there are no direct or implied links to eco-responsible sub-categories from the choices available.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Diffusion-based methods have proven especially useful due to their ability to handle noise and density variations while preserving structure.

new_primary_category.value: Mathematical and Computational Methodology for Data Analysis
new_primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on a new methodological framework for analyzing complex datasets, which is more aligned with advances in computational methods rather than specific eco-responsible goals.
new_primary_category.quote: Here, we establish such a link by using Varadhan’s formula and a parabolic Harnack inequality, which relate manifold distances to heat diffusion directly.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: This sub-category better describes the specific focus on the methodological advancements made for dimensionality reduction using heat diffusion perspectives.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We define the heat-geodesic dissimilarity based on Varadhan’s formula and the two-sided heat kernel bounds.
